message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
A long weekend is created when a statutory holiday falls on a Friday, a Monday, or is observed on a Monday after a weekend‑day holiday.  The list below includes all **federal** holidays that generate a 3‑day weekend.  (Provincial holidays that also create long weekends vary by province – see the “Provincial notes” section for a quick reference.)

| Date Range (2023) | Holiday (Observed) | Notes |
|-------------------|--------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (Observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday; the following Monday is a holiday. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, SK, NB, PEI, etc.) | Family Day is the third Monday in February in most provinces. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is a statutory holiday on Friday. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is the Monday before May 25. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (Observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday; the following Monday is a holiday. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Labour Day is the first Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is the second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day | Remembrance Day is a statutory holiday on Friday. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day | Christmas Day is on Monday. |

### Provincial notes (short‑form)

| Province | Typical long‑weekend holidays (2023) |
|----------|-------------------------------------|
| **Alberta** | Family Day (Feb 20), Good Friday (Apr 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (Jul 3), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25) |
| **British Columbia** | Family Day (Feb 20), Good Friday (Apr 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (Jul 3), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25) |
| **Manitoba** | Good Friday (Apr 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (Jul 3), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25) |
| **New Brunswick** | Family Day (Feb 20), Good Friday (Apr 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (Jul 3), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25) |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | Good Friday (Apr 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (Jul 3), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25) |
| **Nova Scotia** | Good Friday (Apr 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (Jul 3), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25) |
| **Ontario** | Family Day (Feb 20), Good Friday (Apr 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (Jul 3), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25) |
| **Prince Edward Island** | Family Day (Feb 20), Good Friday (Apr 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (Jul 3), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25) |
| **Quebec** | Good Friday (Apr 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (Jul 3), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25) |
| **Saskatchewan** | Family Day (Feb 20), Good Friday (Apr 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (Jul 3), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25) |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - If you need province‑specific long weekends, you can cross‑reference the above table with the province you’re targeting.  
> - For holidays that fall on a weekend, Canada observes the holiday on the following Monday, which automatically creates a long weekend.  

Let me know if you’d like the full list of all statutory holidays (including those that don’t create long weekends) or a province‑by‑province breakdown!
